title: mentha × kerneri var. andersoniana
intro: Mentha × kerneri var. andersoniana, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a hybrid mint species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to alleviate digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and relieve respiratory problems. The health benefits of Mountain Mint include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing the digestive system, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Mint include menthone, limonene, and carvone, which are responsible for its distinctive aroma and medicinal properties.
